contracts.declared_mechanism: guardrail_before_tool_call's gmail_draft branch: when tool.name == 'gmail_draft', _check_gmail_draft(args, tool_context) runs the layered checks; a non-None result is converted by _block into a returned dict ({"error": ...}), which per the callback contract replaces the result and skips execution (guardrails.py:171-180, 188-191, 194-269); a passing check records the draft count in session state (guardrails.py:177, 312-316).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A gmail_draft call having: a malformed recipient address; more than 3 recipients; a recipient not on the configured allowlist (when non-empty); a body over 5000 characters; subject+body containing PII-shaped data (credit-card/SSN/phone/IBAN/AWS key/GitHub token/Slack token/OpenAI-shaped key/PEM private key patterns); a prompt-injection phrase; a phishing phrase; a raw-IP-address or known-link-shortener URL; or being made when the session has already recorded MAX_DRAFTS_PER_SESSION (10) created drafts (guardrails.py:194-269, 303-309).

contracts.protection_obligation: Every gmail_draft invocation must pass the gmail_draft policy branch of guardrail_before_tool_call before execution reaches Gmail's users().drafts().create(): recipient address shape, recipient count cap (MAX_DRAFT_RECIPIENTS = 3), optional recipient allowlist (GUARDRAIL_DRAFT_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST), body-size cap (MAX_DRAFT_BODY_CHARS = 5000), PII-shaped content scan, prompt-injection phrase scan, phishing phrase scan, suspicious-URL scan (raw-IP hosts and known shorteners), and the per-session draft rate limit (MAX_DRAFTS_PER_SESSION = 10, tracked in session state key 'guardrail:gmail_draft_count'). A failing check blocks the call with an error dict that skips tool execution. (Merged from both reviewers' wording on the risky-gmail_draft-args layer.)
scope_limits: The argument/content checks run only when tool.name == 'gmail_draft' (guardrails.py:171); every other tool receives only the forbidden-name check.
The recipient allowlist is opt-in and off by default: an empty GUARDRAIL_DRAFT_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST means no restriction (guardrails.py:79-86).
The per-session rate limit applies only when tool_context.state exists; with no session state (e.g., direct call) nothing is rate-limited (guardrails.py:303-309).
Content scans (PII, injection, phishing, URLs) cover subject+body only (content = f"{subject}\n{body}", guardrails.py:227); the recipient field is checked only for shape, count, and allowlist.
Checks are first-fire-wins: one block reason is returned per call (guardrails.py:36-38).
The guarded effect is draft creation only; the supplied gmail.py contains no send-shaped Gmail API call (gmail.py:1-9, 69-71), so this policy gates nothing else on the send path.
